intent.purpose: Records the assessment and the plan as free text written by a clinician. The plan holds what a clinician wrote; the element never suggests, orders or automates anything.
intent.rationale: Free text carried over from the EMR basic_emr set; no value, band or threshold.
intent.setting: Any clinical setting in the synthetic demo.
